tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: The SlopScore feed. sort: hot|new|top; t: day|week|month|year|all; page.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Full-text search with operators: category: lang: tool: bucket: platform: status: owner: … prefix - to exclude.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: One listing: disclosures, tags, scan report, comments.

tools.name: get_queue
tools.description: The public moderation queue and the site's capacity (free/paid mode, AI budget, scans left).

tools.name: ping_repo
tools.description: Ask SlopScore to scan a GitHub repo that has a slopscore.md now (1 per 10 min per repo).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The GitHub identity behind the bearer token, if any.

tools.name: vote
tools.description: Vote on a listed repo. value 1, -1, or 0 to clear. Needs a bearer token.

tools.name: comment
tools.description: Comment on a listed repo (markdown, ≤ 4000 chars, ≤ 2 links). Needs a bearer token. Flagged comments are held for a moderator.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Report a listing (quietly). reason: objectionable|undisclosed|malware|spam|not-slop|other. Needs a bearer token.
